people.name: Gera
people.line: Benjamite; cursed David during Absalom's rebellion; later sought forgiveness.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, when he had come over the Jordan.
translations.bsb: and crossed at the ford to carry over the king’s household and to do what was good in his sight. When Shimei son of Gera crossed the Jordan, he fell down before the king
translations.kjv: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
translations.asv: And there went over a ferry-boat to bring over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, when he was come over the Jordan.
